instruction: Set up a DRBD resource for synchronous replication
output:
<think>
Goal: We'll execute the system administration command with appropriate options for this scenario.

Plan: I'll use `resource` as the primary tool — resource command execution and management. A multi-line script is used here for clarity — each step builds on the previous one.

Precautions: Verify the command succeeded by checking the exit code with `echo $?` (0 = success). After execution, validate that the system behaves as expected before closing the task.

resource r0 {
  protocol C;
  on node1 {
    device /dev/drbd0;
    disk /dev/sdb1;
    address 192.168.1.10:7788;
  }
  on node2 {
    device /dev/drbd0;
    disk /dev/sdb1;
    address 192.168.1.11:7788;
  }
}
